svg.title: Download speed and responsiveness
svg.desc: Two aligned horizontal bar charts compare download throughput, where higher is better, and loaded reply 95th-percentile latency, where lower is better. They show five single observations while a bulk download and small requests share a 500 Mbps down, 100 Mbps up link. The dashed line marks the configured 500 Mbps download capacity. MPTUNNEL TCP+QUIC: 406.3 Mbps download throughput and 797.1 ms loaded reply p95; Hysteria2: 366.6 Mbps download throughput and 426.7 ms loaded reply p95; MPTUNNEL QUIC: 343.4 Mbps download throughput and 153.6 ms loaded reply p95; Direct TCP: 294.8 Mbps download throughput and 121.9 ms loaded reply p95; Xray VMess/TCP: 286.3 Mbps download throughput and 122.1 ms loaded reply p95.
svg.title: Download speed and responsiveness
